outcome: insulin-like growth factor 1 (IGF-1) levels in urine
cohort: The study included 70 extremely (<28 weeks) and very (28-32 weeks) preterm infants.
finding: Approximately one-fifth of the variation in urinary levels of adipokines (leptin, adiponectin, ghrelin) and IGF-1 in the early postnatal stage of preterm infants was associated with factors such as infant's sex, extreme preterm gestation, low 1-minute Apgar score, or birth to nulliparous/primigravida mothers.
cross-section timing: Within 48 hours after birth and before the initiation of enteral nutrition.
birth_weight: The study included preterm infants, 18.6% of whom were born with a weight <750 grams; birth weight was also a measured factor.
gest_age: Born at 32 or fewer weeks of gestation (less than 28 weeks for extremely preterm, 28-32 weeks for very preterm).
